_readme: QUEENSTOWN FIXED-PRICE MENU. These are researched prices, not placeholders.
Where they came from: Queenstown call-out plus first-hour rates as advertised in November 2026 (DECISIONS.md).

New trades and their jobs added 24 November 2026 (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-24): each such item says where its price came from in 'source'. Items whose price has no Queenstown figure behind it carry needsLocalQuote and load switched off.
This file only fills an EMPTY database, the first time the site is deployed. After that, change prices on the admin screen: More > Markets, prices and the menu.
Prices are in whole dollars and include GST.
ownerPriceDollars is what the owner's card is charged. tradiePayoutDollars is what the tradie receives.
The gap is what the platform keeps: a 15% fee on the owner price. Every owner price is payout / 0.85 rounded to the nearest $5.
licenceRequired is true for any plumbing, gas, electrical or drainlaying work. Builder jobs also need an LBP number on file (config/trades.ts).
needsLocalQuote: the price came from national averages, not a Queenstown quote. These load SWITCHED OFF. Ring a local, fix the price, then tick 'On the menu' on the admin screen.
isAddOn: only makes sense alongside another job on the same visit. These load SWITCHED OFF, because the app cannot attach an add-on to a job yet.
guestVisible false: a job the owner arranges. Guests do not see it on the QR code form.
seasonal and tags are notes for people. Nothing in the app reads them yet.
